deferred.claim: Cast normally for the printed cost; create three 1/1 white Ninja Turtle Spirit creature tokens.
deferred.basis: Create three 1/1 white Ninja Turtle Spirit creature tokens. If this spell's sneak cost was paid, they enter tapped and attacking.

deferred.claim: Cast for the sneak alternative cost of {1}{W}, also returning an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step; create three 1/1 white Ninja Turtle Spirit creature tokens tapped and attacking.
deferred.basis: Sneak {1}{W} (You may cast this spell for {1}{W} if you also return an unblocked attacker you control to hand during the declare blockers step.) ... Create three 1/1 white Ninja Turtle Spirit creature tokens. If this spell's sneak cost was paid, they enter tapped and attacking.
